title: The ocean in numbers
intro: Pick the range that holds the real value. Closer ranges score more.

items.prompt: The average depth of the ocean is about
items.explain: NOAA gives an average ocean depth of 3,682 m.

items.prompt: The ocean covers about this share of Earth's surface:
items.explain: NOAA states that the ocean covers about 71 percent of Earth's surface.

items.prompt: The deepest part of the ocean, Challenger Deep, is about this deep:
items.explain: NOAA gives about 10,935 m for Challenger Deep.

items.prompt: The Pacific Ocean has an area of about
items.explain: NOAA states approximately 63 million square miles for the Pacific Ocean.
